children: Kathleen Patricia Sullivan, an officer serving as Principal Accounting Officer, reported direct sales of Class A Common Stock on September 2, 2026 and September 3, 2026. The September 2 sales were executed at a weighted average price of $13.1538 per share and the September 3 sales at a weighted average price of $13.1648 per share. The total sale amount reported across the transactions is $526,317. Following the reported sales, Sullivan directly beneficially owns 44,795 Class A Common Stock. The reporting person stated she will provide, upon request, full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate price within the ranges set forth in the filing.
